summary.en: You can bring "burnable" waste and "non-burnable and bulky" waste (separately). If you take garbage to a facility by car, from 11 January 2027 you will generally need to reserve a facility and time online in advance. Until 8 January 2027, register at the environmental office of the ward where the garbage was produced and deliver it the same day. Between 14 December and 8 January both methods can be used, and online booking is planned to open from 7 December (to be checked). The Oe crushing plant and Inokoishi plant stop accepting self-delivery after 8 January (to be checked). Reservation slots are limited. If you get a fee reduction (e.g. disaster waste), you cannot book online: ask the Environmental Office. You cannot bring garbage on foot or by bicycle. The four home appliance types (air conditioner, TV, refrigerator, washing machine) and PCs cannot be brought.
